data.name: Airborne
data.description: A unit that is airborne is unable to move, attack, cast abilities, or use item actives for the duration.

data.name: Knock aside
data.description: A knock aside causes the unit to be made airborne in a direction perpendicular to the direction of cast. (Parent: Airborne)

data.name: Knock back
data.description: A knock back causes the unit to be made airborne in a direction away from the point of cast. (Parent: Airborne)

data.name: Knock up
data.description: A knock up causes the unit to be made airborne on the spot. (Parent: Airborne)

data.name: Pull
data.description: A pull causes the unit to be made airborne in a direction towards the point of cast. (Parent: Airborne)

data.name: Blind
data.description: A unit that is blinded will miss its basic attacks for the duration. Miss occurs on-hit, and does not prevent attacks from being declared.

data.name: Cripple
data.description: A unit that is crippled has reduced attack speed for the duration.

data.name: Disarm
data.description: A unit that is disarmed cannot declare basic attacks for the duration.

data.name: Disrupt
data.description: A unit that is disrupted has its channeled and charged abilities interrupted.

data.name: Drowsy
data.description: A unit that is drowsy is gradually slowed over the duration, falling asleep thereafter.

data.name: Sleep
data.description: A unit that is asleep is unable to move, attack, cast abilities, or use item actives for the duration as long as it doesn't get damaged. (Parent: Drowsy)

data.name: Forced Action
data.description: A unit that is under the effect of a forced action cannot control its own movement or attacks and is unable to cast abilities or use item actives.

data.name: Berserk
data.description: A unit that is berserk will attempt to basic attack a nearby unit for the duration. (Parent: Forced Action)

data.name: Charm
data.description: A unit that is charmed will move toward the source with reduced movement speed for the duration. (Parent: Forced Action)

data.name: Flee
data.description: A unit that is fleeing will move directly away from the source with reduced movement speed for the duration. (Parent: Forced Action)

data.name: Taunt
data.description: A unit that is taunted will attempt to basic attack the source for the duration. (Parent: Forced Action)

data.name: Ground
data.description: A unit that is grounded is unable to activate mobility spells for the duration.

data.name: Kinematics
data.description: A unit affected by kinematics is dragged to a unit or location.

data.name: Knockdown
data.description: A unit that is knocked down has its dash or displacement interrupted and is placed on the ground.

data.name: Nearsight
data.description: A unit that is nearsighted has their sight radius reduced and loses their allied vision for the duration.

data.name: Root
data.description: A unit that is rooted is unable to control its movement or activate mobility spells for the duration.

data.name: Silence
data.description: A unit that is silenced cannot cast abilities or use item actives for the duration.

data.name: Polymorph
data.description: A unit that is polymorphed is silenced and turned into a critter. The only example also applies disarm and reduces movement speed for the duration. (Parent: Silence)

data.name: Slow
data.description: A unit that is slowed has reduced movement speed for the duration.

data.name: Stasis
data.description: A unit that is in stasis is unable to move, attack, cast abilities, or use item actives or summoner spells while being untargetable and invulnerable for the duration.

data.name: Stun
data.description: A unit that is stunned is unable to move, attack, cast abilities, or use item actives for the duration.

data.name: Suspension
data.description: A unit that is suspended is stunned and pretends to be airborne. (Parent: Stun)

data.name: Suppression
data.description: A unit that is suppressed is unable to move, attack, cast abilities, or use item actives or summoner spells for the duration.
